page.overview:
Who is Lee Revkins?

Lee Revkins is a minor character in Cars. He is a purple Axxelo/Fission. He races for the sponsor "Transberry Juice". He grew up on a farm, where he learned to drive.

Lee retires sometime between the events of the first and third films, and is replaced by Markus Krankzler.

"Lee Revkins grew up mastering his driving skill on the family farm. He recalls an old, rickety bridge down at the river running through the property where he'd try to "thread the needle across the narrow bridge." Lee credits his nerves of steel to those daredevil runs. These days Lee threads through Piston Cup traffic every Sunday competing with some of the fastest cars in the world!"

During one of the races, he gets hit off the track by Chick Hicks, in which he previously had the first position.
